Retrieve a SAS URL for a user's avatar.
This endpoint enables lazy loading of user avatars.

Get all non-deleted units.
Returns a list of all units that haven't been soft-deleted.

Use case: Populate dropdown menus for form fields where users select units of measurement.

200.description: The created/restored unit or an error message

post.description:
Create a new unit or restore a soft-deleted one.

If a unit with the same name exists but is soft-deleted, it will be restored
rather than creating a duplicate.

200.description: The unit object or a 404 error if not found

get.description: Get a single unit by its ID.

200.description: The updated unit or an error message
Success message or 404 if not found

delete.description:
Soft-delete a unit.
The unit is not permanently removed from the database but marked as deleted.
This preserves referential integrity for existing form submissions that use this unit.

post.description:
Create or update a form template draft.
If draftId is supplied, the existing draft is updated in place.
Otherwise a new draft document is created.

Use case: Auto-save functionality in form builder - users can save work in progress
before finalizing and creating a published template.
